notes: A single vaporetto ticket costs 9.50 EUR, a 72-hour pass 45 EUR. Venice is best explored on foot (getting lost is normal). From Marco Polo airport, take the Alilaguna boat or the bus.
Day-visitor fee: 5-10 EUR on certain days from April to July (hotel guests are exempt). San Marco and the Doge's Palace require timed online tickets.
Summer brings 30°C heat, humidity and crowds. Visit San Marco at 07:30 and the islands in the afternoon. Mosquitoes in August.
Standing at a bacaro, cicchetti cost 1.5-3 EUR and an ombra 2 EUR. A sit-down meal runs 25-40 EUR, and a café on San Marco 10+ EUR.
Coperto (cover charge) is 3-5 EUR. The official gondola tariff is 90 EUR for 30 minutes and can be shared (up to 6 people).
Watch for pickpockets on bridges and in crowds. Suitcase wheels are a nightmare on cobbles, so pack light.

stops.name: Piazza San Marco
stops.tips: Pigeons and an empty square at 07:30, perfect for photos. After 10:00 it gets packed.

stops.name: Basilica di San Marco
stops.tips: Golden mosaics. Book a timed ticket online (12 EUR); the Pala d'Oro costs extra. Shoulders and knees must be covered.

stops.name: Palazzo Ducale
stops.tips: The Doge's Palace and the Bridge of Sighs. Book online; the Secret Itineraries tour is optional.

stops.name: Campanile di San Marco
stops.tips: Take the lift up the bell tower for views over the lagoon.

stops.name: Rosticceria Gislon
stops.tips: Standing counter behind San Marco. Try the mozzarella in carrozza (fried mozzarella sandwich) and arancini (rice balls). Cheap.

backups.name: Caffè Florian
backups.tips: The square's café since 1720. The orchestra costs extra.

backups.name: Museo Correr
backups.tips: Included with the Doge's Palace ticket. A museum on the square itself.

stops.name: Rialto Fish Market
stops.tips: Morning market with seafood and vegetables. Closed on Mondays.

stops.name: Ponte di Rialto
stops.tips: The bridge over the Grand Canal. Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Cantina Do Mori
stops.tips: A bacaro (Venetian wine bar) since 1462. Eat cicchetti (small bites) and drink an ombra (small glass of wine), standing.

stops.name: Cannaregio Ghetto
stops.tips: The world's first ghetto, with tall houses and synagogues.

stops.name: Fondamenta della Misericordia
stops.tips: A row of canalside bacari in Cannaregio, including Vino Vero and Al Timon. Come in the evening.

backups.name: Al Timon Cannaregio
backups.tips: Tables on a boat, and cicchetti.

backups.name: Ca' d'Oro
backups.tips: A Gothic palace on the Grand Canal. Visit it instead of the Ghetto.

stops.name: Gallerie dell'Accademia
stops.tips: Venetian painting: Bellini, Titian, Veronese. Book online.

stops.name: Peggy Guggenheim Collection
stops.tips: Modern art on the canal, with a garden.

stops.name: Punta della Dogana
stops.tips: The tip of the canal, with the Salute church and San Marco across the water.

stops.name: Cantine del Vino già Schiavi
stops.tips: A legendary cicchetti bar. Stand by the canal; it closes at 14:30.

stops.name: Zattere Waterfront
stops.tips: Walk along the Giudecca Canal and try the gianduiotto (chocolate-hazelnut gelato) at Gelateria Nico.

backups.name: Squero di San Trovaso
backups.tips: A gondola-building boatyard. View it from the outside.

stops.name: Murano Glass Workshop
stops.tips: Take vaporetto 4.1 or 4.2 (day pass 25 EUR). Watch a glassblowing demonstration; the Murano Glass Museum costs 10 EUR.

stops.name: Museo del Vetro Murano
stops.tips: The glass museum.

stops.name: Burano Colourful Houses
stops.tips: Take vaporetto 12 for 40 minutes. Brightly painted fishermen's houses and a leaning bell tower.

stops.name: Trattoria al Gatto Nero Burano
stops.tips: Burano's famous risotto di gò (goby fish risotto). Book ahead.

stops.name: Mazzorbo Venissa Vineyard
stops.tips: An island linked to Burano by a bridge. A walled vineyard and a quiet stroll; return by vaporetto.

backups.name: Burano Bussolà Bakery
backups.tips: Bussolà biscuits. Choose this instead of Gatto Nero.

backups.name: Torcello Santa Maria Assunta
backups.tips: A cathedral with Byzantine mosaics. Visit it instead of Mazzorbo.

stops.name: Arsenale di Venezia
stops.tips: The shipyard gate and its lions. Exhibitions run in Biennale years (May to November).

stops.name: Via Garibaldi
stops.tips: A local Castello street, good for breakfast and the market.

stops.name: Giardini della Biennale
stops.tips: The Biennale gardens. A park when there is no exhibition.

stops.name: San Pietro di Castello
stops.tips: Venice's old cathedral, on a quiet island.

stops.name: Trattoria alla Rampa del Piave
stops.tips: A local trattoria on Via Garibaldi. Seafood pasta.

backups.name: Scuola di San Giorgio degli Schiavoni
backups.tips: Carpaccio's painting cycle. Visit it instead of San Pietro.

stops.name: San Giorgio Maggiore
stops.tips: Take vaporetto 2 to the island. A Palladio church, and the bell tower gives the best view of San Marco.

stops.name: Giudecca Walk
stops.tips: A quiet island across from Zattere, with the Redentore church.

stops.name: Trattoria Altanella Giudecca
stops.tips: Canalside since 1920. Fish.

stops.name: Gondola Ride
stops.tips: The official tariff is 90 EUR for 30 minutes (110 EUR at night). Depart from Bacino Orseolo.

stops.name: Vaporetto 1 Grand Canal at Sunset
stops.tips: Line 1 from Piazzale Roma to San Marco. Grab a front seat for the palace façades.

backups.name: Harry's Dolci Giudecca
backups.tips: Cipriani's pastry shop and restaurant on Giudecca. Choose it instead of Altanella.

backups.name: Fondazione Cini
backups.tips: A monastery tour on San Giorgio. Visit it instead of Giudecca.

stops.name: Scuola Grande di San Rocco
stops.tips: Sixty paintings by Tintoretto. Use a mirror to see the ceiling.

stops.name: Frari Basilica
stops.tips: Titian's Assumption in a Gothic church.

stops.name: Pasticceria Tonolo
stops.tips: Venice's best pastry shop. Try the cream pastries and frittelle (carnival fritters).

stops.name: Campo Santa Margherita
stops.tips: The students' square. Have a last spritz.

stops.name: Piazzale Roma / Vaporetto Alilaguna
stops.tips: To Marco Polo airport, take the Alilaguna boat (1 hour) or the bus (20 minutes). Farewell.

backups.name: Ca' Pesaro
backups.tips: A palace of modern art. Visit it instead of San Rocco.
